context: Two friends recall a funny mishap from years ago
purpose: Teach: 仲良く/限っ/接触/伺っ/問う/ラッキー/もったいない/言い訳

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、覚えてる？高校の時、私たち本当に仲良くしてたよね。
lines.en: Hey, do you remember? Back in high school, we really got along well.
lines.style: warm nostalgic opening, soft and friendly tone with a gentle smile to an old friend

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: もちろん覚えてるよ！特にあの自転車の接触事故、忘れられない！
lines.en: Of course I remember! Especially that bicycle collision, unforgettable!
lines.style: bright energetic teen voice, slightly teasing with playful laughter bubbling through

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの日に限って私、新しいスカート履いてたんだよね…もったいない話だよ。
lines.en: On that day of all days, I was wearing a new skirt… such a waste.
lines.style: sighing softly, wistful and a little embarrassed, drawn-out vowels with a rueful chuckle

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しかも先生に「なんで前見てなかったの」ってめっちゃ詰められてたよね。
lines.en: And on top of that, the teacher really grilled you with 'why weren't you looking ahead?'
lines.style: animated storytelling, mimicking a stern teacher voice with exaggerated emphasis

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私、必死に言い訳してたの覚えてる？「鳥が飛んできて」とか。
lines.en: Do you remember me desperately making excuses? Like 'a bird flew at me'?
lines.style: laughing at herself, embarrassed but amused, voice cracking slightly with self-mockery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あれ本気で問うてる感じだったから、聞いてる私もハラハラしたよ。
lines.en: She was seriously demanding an answer, so even I was on edge listening.
lines.style: lively teen tone shifting to mock-tense recollection, then easing into a grin

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 後で保健室の先生にも事情を伺って、結局怪我なくてラッキーだったよね。
lines.en: Later the nurse asked me about it too, and in the end I was lucky to escape uninjured.
lines.style: soft sincere voice with relieved warmth, fond but unromantic friend-to-friend reflection

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ね！怪我の功名ってやつ？また今度ゆっくり昔話聞かせてよ。
lines.en: Right! A blessing in disguise, huh? Let me hear more old stories next time.
lines.style: cheerful upbeat closing, bouncy teen energy with a friendly inviting lilt
